sources.label: PD 1586: EIS System — Ecological Considerations in Site Planning
sources.description: Requires environmental impact assessment for projects in or near ecologically sensitive areas. Governs ecological site analysis.

sources.label: PD 1067: Water Code — Ecological Water Management in Site Planning
sources.description: Governs water management, watershed protection, and ecological water flow in relation to site development.

sources.label: DENR DAO 2003-30 — Environmental Impact Assessment including Ecological Factors
sources.description: Specifies ecological assessment requirements during site planning including wildlife habitat survey, vegetation analysis, and water resource evaluation.
